card.statement:
Let ${\mathcal P}:\pair{U}{V}{\mathcal
A}{\mathcal B}$ be a pair of linear mappings over a field $\mathbb F$, and let <<ref:loz>> be a sequence of pairs of linear mappings on vector spaces over $\mathbb F$ that has been constructed according to the preceding formal description. Then there exist bases of the spaces $U$ and $V$ in which $(\mathcal A,\mathcal B)$ is given by the direct sum of the following matrix pairs:

- a pair of nonsingular matrices that gives ${\mathcal
    P}_{3\ell_3}=(\mathcal
    A_{3\ell_3},\mathcal
    B_{3\ell_3})$,

- $(\dim V_{1j}-\dim
      V_{1,j+1})-(\dim U_{1j} -\dim
      U_{1,j+1})$ copies of $(L_j^T,R_j^T)$, $1\le
      j<\ell_1$,

- $(\dim U_{1j}-\dim
      U_{1,j+1})-(\dim V_{1,j+1}
      -\dim V_{1,j+2})$ copies of $(I_j,J_j(0))$, $1\le
      j<\ell_1$,

- $\dim V_{2j}-2\dim
      V_{2,j+1}+\dim V_{2,j+2}$ copies of $(J_j(0),I_j)$, $1\le j<\ell_2$,

- $\dim U_{3j}-2\dim
      U_{3,j+1}+\dim
      U_{3,j+2}$\footnote{This sum was written in [Linear Algebra Appl. 450 (2014) 121--137] incorrectly as follows: $\dim V_{3j}-2\dim
      V_{3,j+1}+\dim V_{3,j+2}$.} copies of $(L_j,R_j)$, $1\le
      j<\ell_3$.

This direct sum is a regularizing decomposition for each matrix pair that gives ${\mathcal P}$ in some bases of $U$ and $V$.
card.label: Theorem 2

paper.title: Regularizing decompositions for matrix pencils and a topological classification of pairs of linear mappings
paper.abstract: We give a method for constructing a regularizing decomposition of a matrix pencil, which is formulated in terms of the linear mappings. We prove that two pencils are topologically equivalent if and only if their regularizing decompositions coincide up to permutation of summands and their regular parts coincide up to homeomorphisms of their spaces.
